notes: HotSpawn is used for fixture discovery and the final score only; its crowd pick percentage is never read, stored or used as an input.
Kalshi legs keep bid/ask/spread: a two-sided thin book is published with a flag instead of being dropped, and a one-sided book is refused.
HLTV is probed on every run; when it refuses the runner the failure is published and HLTV can only be cited as a dated, interactive cross-check.
